title: Top Shelf Sparkling Margarita Jell-O
description: All the ingredients and flavors of a cold margarita are combined in a lemon-lime gelatin-based treat. For grown-ups only!
ingredients: 3 (3 ounce) packages lime-flavored gelatin mix (such as Jell-O®)
1 (3 ounce) package lemon-flavored gelatin mix (such as Jell-O®)
0.66666668653488 cup brandy-based orange liqueur (such as Grand Marnier®)
1 pinch margarita salt, or as needed

steps.text: Stir lime gelatin, lemon gelatin, and boiling water together in a bowl until fully dissolved. Chill in refrigerator for 15 minutes.

Stir tequila, triple sec, orange liqueur, and sweetened lime juice into gelatin mixture. Gently stir in sparkling water. Ladle mixture into 24 small cups. Sprinkle each serving with lime zest. Refrigerate until set, at least 4 hours. Sprinkle each serving with margarita salt before serving.

video.description: Try this fun and wacky drink for your next party! Lemon, lime, tequila, triple sec, and orange liqueur make this drink pop! Plus the addition of sparkling water makes it more vibrant. This drink is tart, sweet, and enjoyable to guzzle down! Top with some lemon zest for that little bit of extra pizzazz!
